description: Mixing mechanisms (arXiv:2510.06182), TargetRebind interchange on gemma-2-2b-it: swap the counterfactual run's last-token residual into the original run, swept over layers around the paper's most-mixed region (~18 of 26), on the Music binding task, first-position query bucket (per-bucket documents keep the single-batch lm_head forward within GPU memory) (m=3, n=20 groups, t_entity=2). Per row the positional / lexical / reflexive mechanisms predict distinct single-token genres (pos_answer / lex_answer / ref_answer columns; see gen_mixing.py for the permutation construction); match metrics attribute each query to a mechanism, and the test computes positional shares at first/middle/last query-position buckets at the most-mixed layer. Goldens: edges >= 60% (figure-read, confidence low), middle in [5, 35] (paper text: 'accounting only for 20%').
